question: How do I map an OBX segment for body height to a FHIR Observation?
answer:
# Mapping HL7 v2 OBX (Body Height) to FHIR R4 Observation

## OBX Segment Example
```
OBX|1|NM|8302-2^Body Height^LN||173.9|cm^centimeter^UCUM|||||F|||20100301062241-0500
```

---

## FHIR R4 Observation Mapping

### Field-by-Field Mapping Table

| OBX Field | OBX Value | FHIR Element | FHIR Value |
|---|---|---|---|
| OBX-2 (Value Type) | `NM` (Numeric) | `valueQuantity` | *(determines value type)* |
| OBX-3 (Observation ID) | `8302-2^Body Height^LN` | `code.coding[0]` | LOINC `8302-2` |
| OBX-5 (Observation Value) | `173.9` | `valueQuantity.value` | `173.9018914060253` |
| OBX-6 (Units) | `cm^centimeter^UCUM` | `valueQuantity.unit` / `.system` / `.code` | `cm` / UCUM |
| OBX-11 (Observation Status) | `F` (Final) | `status` | `final` |
| OBX-14 (Date/Time) | `20100301062241-0500` | `effectiveDateTime` | `2010-03-01T06:22:41-05:00` |
| *(implied by LOINC code)* | — | `category` | `vital-signs` |

---

## Resulting FHIR R4 Observation Resource

```json
{
  "resourceType": "Observation",
  "status": "final",
  "category": [
    {
      "coding": [
        {
          "system": "http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/observation-category",
          "code": "vital-signs",
          "display": "Vital Signs"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "code": {
    "coding": [
      {
        "system": "http://loinc.org",
        "code": "8302-2",
        "display": "Body Height"
      }
    ]
  },
  "effectiveDateTime": "2010-03-01T06:22:41-05:00",
  "valueQuantity": {
    "value": 173.9018914060253,
    "unit": "cm",
    "system": "http://unitsofmeasure.org",
    "code": "cm"
  }
}
```

---

## Key Mapping Notes

### 1. Value Type → FHIR Value Element
> **OBX-2 = `NM` (Numeric)** maps to **`valueQuantity`**, as confirmed by Evidence [1] which uses `valueQuantity` for the numeric body height value of `173.9018914060253 cm`.

### 2. LOINC Code System URI
- OBX-3 uses `LN` as the coding system identifier
- In FHIR, this becomes `"system": "http://loinc.org"`

### 3. Units (UCUM)
- OBX-6 UCUM units map to `valueQuantity` with:
  - `"system": "http://unitsofmeasure.org"`
  - `"code": "cm"` *(UCUM code)*
  - `"unit": "cm"` *(human-readable display)*

### 4. Category Auto-Assignment
- LOINC code `8302-2` is a well-known vital sign; the `vital-signs` category should be added per FHIR vital signs profile requirements (confirmed by Evidence [1]).

### 5. Status Mapping
| OBX-11 Code | FHIR `status` |
|---|---|
| `F` | `final` |
| `P` | `preliminary` |
| `C` | `corrected` |

---

> **Related observations** from the same encounter (Evidence [2] & [3]) — Body Weight (`29463-7`, `84.17 kg`) and BMI (`39156-5`, `27.83 kg/m2`) — follow the identical mapping pattern using `valueQuantity` with their respective UCUM units (`kg` and `kg/m2`).
